name: 90402 · Santa Monica, CA
findings: ZIP 90402 (Santa Monica) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90402 (Santa Monica) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90402 (Santa Monica) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 27 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
